usbids.claim: Registry lists 05ac:12a7 as TV Device; no exact model or firmware state is specified.

usbmuxd.claim: Recognizes Apple product range 1290..12af and interface class/subclass/protocol ff/fe/02. Descriptor compatibility does not prove protocol or firmware health.

libirecovery.claim: Public mode enum defines recovery PIDs 1280..1283, DFU 1227, WTF 1222, and port DFU f014; IDs are shared across products.

apple_model.claim: Apple lists A1427/A1469 as third-generation Apple TV models; verify the physical label separately. No USB PID mapping is provided.

libirecovery_interfaces.claim: Recovery receive path selects interface 1 alternate 1 and bulk IN 0x81; consistent with the observed configuration alternatives, without proving protocol behavior.

usb_dfu_1_1.claim: DFU-mode interface uses fe/01/02 with zero non-control endpoints. A class triple alone does not establish a conformant descriptor set or authenticated boot state.
